items.q: Erskine Hawkins. We had – teenage guys, we used to hang out – we had all the records, After Hours. I was listening to everything.

ctx.x: Right. Erskine Hawkins. We had – teenage guys, we used to hang out – we had all the records, After Hours. I was listening to everything.
